title: Shot feedback component in C++: recoil, muzzle flash, tracer, impact flash, haptics, placeholder sound (for T-0015)
acceptance: Every shot drives barrel/mount recoil, muzzle discharge, a cosmetic tracer from muzzle to end, an impact flash on hits, a haptic pulse on that hand and a report sound
Haptic strength (0 = off) and reduced flash respected
description: Split from T-0015, whose paths cover only content. Placeholder geometry and engine materials/sounds until art and audio exist (T-0034, T-0036).
